subject: Transportation Systems
title: Transfer Penalties
description: A fast breakdown of Transfer Penalties for builders.

hook.text: Every time a rider transfers between vehicles, some percentage of potential riders give up entirely.

buildup.text: Studies show each transfer feels like 10 to 15 extra minutes of travel time—even if the wait is short.

discovery.text: That's the transfer penalty. It makes multi-leg trips feel much worse than direct ones.

twist.text: But direct routes everywhere mean low frequency everywhere. A good network has a few key transfer points.

climax.text: The trick is making transfers painless—same platform, timed arrivals, clear signage.

punchline.text: The best transfer is the one that doesn't feel like one.

quiz.question: What is the transfer penalty?
options: The perceived extra time burden of changing vehicles
